questions.question: Explain the terms real self and ideal self?
questions.solution_html:
• Carl Rogers – person centered theory - real self (one’s actual perception of characteristics, traits and
  • abilities that form the basis of the striving for self actualization) - ideal self (the perception of what a person
  • would like to be or thinks he or she should be)
questions.final_answer: would like to be or thinks he or she should be)
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Interpret the progression from Dharana to Dhyana to Samadhi in yoga, / . ]
questions.solution_html:
• Dharana, dhyana and Samadhi are the exercises that help gain control of the mind. Dharana
  • – focusing the mind on a single point or object. Dhyana (meditation) - state of deep
  • contemplation. Samadhi (integration) – a state of blissful union with the divine.
questions.final_answer: contemplation. Samadhi (integration) – a state of blissful union with the divine
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: What does high neuroticism indicate about a person's emotional state?
questions.solution_html:
• Neuroticism refers to emotional instability or stability . high score indicate the individual is overanxious
  • has excessive worries and is moody – has unstable emotions – insecure and temperamental
questions.final_answer: Neuroticism refers to emotional instability or stability . high score indicate the individual is overanxious
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
